verdict.rationale: Turso's core engine, libSQL (a fork of SQLite), is confirmed open source under the MIT license by both the official GitHub repo and a Turso employee's community comment, giving genuine buyer-relevant proof of open licensing for the product's foundational code. However, it's unclear whether the Turso Cloud platform, CLI, or hosted service layer are also open-sourced, so the story is only partially satisfied. missing for 10: confirmation that the full product stack (cloud platform/CLI, not just the libSQL engine) is open-sourced, and independent hands-on verification of the license terms.
